title: Filter high amounts
body: Return rows where `amount` > 1000.

title: Select and rename
body: Select `id`, `name` and rename `name` to `customer_name`.

title: Add total column
body: Add column `total` = `qty` * `price`.

title: Drop null keys
body: Remove rows where `order_id` is null.

title: Cast id to string
body: Cast `customer_id` to string type.

title: Group sum by region
body: Total `sales` per `region`.

title: Distinct countries
body: Return distinct `country` values.

title: Fill null country
body: Replace null `country` with 'UNK'.
solution:
def fill_country(df):
    return df.fillna({"country": "UNK"})

title: Conditional flag
body: Add `is_premium` = 1 if `amount` >= 500 else 0.

title: Explode tags
body: Explode array column `tags` into rows.

title: Inner join orders customers
body: Inner join `orders` and `customers` on `customer_id`.
solution:
def join_orders_customers(orders, customers):
    return orders.join(customers, on="customer_id", how="inner")

title: Left join enrich
body: Left join `facts` with `dim` on `id`, keep all facts.
solution:
def left_enrich(facts, dim):
    return facts.join(dim, facts.id == dim.id, "left")

title: Broadcast join
body: Join large `facts` to small `lookup` using broadcast.

title: Anti join
body: Rows in `all_customers` not in `active` on `id`.
solution:
def inactive_customers(all_customers, active):
    return all_customers.join(active.select("id"), "id", "left_anti")

title: Multi-key join
body: Join on `region` and `product_id`.
solution:
def multi_join(a, b):
    return a.join(b, ["region", "product_id"], "inner")

title: Semi join active customers
body: Return customers who have at least one order (left semi join).
solution:
def active_customers(customers, orders):
    return customers.join(orders, "customer_id", "left_semi")

title: Row number dedupe
body: Keep one row per `user_id` — latest by `ts` (row_number = 1).

title: Running sum
body: Running sum of `amount` per `account_id` ordered by `dt`.

title: Lag previous amount
body: Previous `amount` per `user_id` ordered by `event_time`.

title: Rank by revenue
body: Dense rank `revenue` per `region` descending.

title: 7-day moving avg
body: Moving average of `value` over last 7 rows per `sensor_id`.

title: Lead next status
body: Add `next_status` using `lead()` per `customer_id` ordered by `updated_at`.

title: Repartition before write
body: Repartition to 10 files before write.
solution:
def repartition_write(df, path):
    df.repartition(10).write.mode("overwrite").parquet(path)

title: Cache and use
body: Cache `dim` and join twice to same fact.
solution:
def cache_dim_join(fact, dim):
    dim_cached = dim.cache()
    a = fact.join(dim_cached, "id")
    b = fact.join(dim_cached, "id")
    dim_cached.unpersist()
    return a, b

title: Partition prune filter
body: Read only `dt = '2024-01-01'` partition from orders.

title: Coalesce output files
body: Write with coalesce(4) to limit output files.
solution:
def write_coalesced(df, path):
    df.coalesce(4).write.mode("overwrite").parquet(path)

title: Select columns early
body: Project only needed columns before join.
solution:
def project_before_join(fact, dim):
    return fact.select("id", "amount").join(dim.select("id", "name"), "id")

title: Salt skewed key
body: Add random salt column 0–9 for skewed join prep.

title: Enable AQE
body: Set Spark conf to enable AQE and skew join.

title: Dynamic partition overwrite
body: Configure dynamic partition overwrite mode.
solution:
def enable_dynamic_overwrite(spark):
    spark.conf.set("spark.sql.sources.partitionOverwriteMode", "dynamic")
